description: This file provides utility functions for fetching and processing SEC financial statement data, specifically related to SEC XBRL frames and company concepts. It includes asynchronous functions to retrieve data, handle caching, and process financial facts into DataFrames for further analysis.

methods.name: Union[Dict,List[Dict]] fetch_data(url, use_cache, persist)
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data from a given URL, utilizing cache if specified.

methods.name: Dict get_frame( fact: str = "Revenues", year: Optional[int] = None, fiscal_period: Optional[FISCAL_PERIODS] = None, taxonomy: Optional[TAXONOMIES] = "us-gaap", units: Optional[str] = "USD", instantaneous: bool = False, use_cache: bool = True, )
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a financial data frame for a specified fact, period, and other parameters from SEC's API, returning structured metadata and data as a dictionary with a DataFrame conversion.

methods.name: Dict get_concept( symbol: str, fact: str = "Revenues", year: Optional[int] = None, taxonomy: Optional[TAXONOMIES] = "us-gaap", use_cache: bool = True, )
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves all disclosures related to a company's specific financial fact for one or multiple companies, returning a structured dictionary containing metadata and sorted data entries.
